headline: Mercedes-Benz Lowers 2026 Profit Guidance as China Sales Slump
summary: Mercedes-Benz reduced its 2026 earnings outlook, pointing to weakening sales conditions in China and higher fourth-quarter costs for materials, despite posting higher third-quarter net profit.
why: Mercedes-Benz is a bellwether for European luxury automotive demand and relies heavily on China for top-margin vehicle sales.

impacts.name: Mercedes-Benz Group AG
impacts.why: Weakening Chinese deliveries and anticipated material cost increases dampened full-year profit projections.
